title: Cookies & Milk Baby Shower
description: Royal blue over black linen, run the full length of a banquet table. Blue and white plates alternate down a satin runner scattered with eucalyptus and cream blooms, with a milk-bottle centrepiece at the middle and printed favours at every cover. A cookies-and-milk sign anchors the head of the table, and lettered baby blocks with tissue poms close the room at the far wall.
